# nuxt-backend/presence

**`Experimental`**

Who is here: Convex's presence component, behind the backend's sign-in.
A heartbeat counts the signed-in account, never an id the browser names;
the room token it hands back is what lists the room, so only someone the
room let in reads who else is there, by name.

Experimental: it follows the presence component's pre-1.0 shapes, so this
entry's shape may change in a minor release.

### SetupPresenceOptions

Defined in: [src/convex/integrations/presence.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/integrations/presence.ts)

**`Experimental`**

Options for [setupPresence](#setuppresence).

#### Properties

| Property | Type | Description | Defined in |
| ------ | ------ | ------ | ------ |
| <a id="canjoin"></a> `canJoin?` | (`room`, `ctx`) => `boolean` \| `Promise`\<`boolean`\> | **`Experimental`** Whether a signed-in account may join a room, with the mutation's `ctx` to read your tables by. Unset, every signed-in account may join any room; refuse one by returning `false`, and the heartbeat answers `forbidden`. Rooms are the app's own strings: a document's id, `workspace:<id>`. **Example** `canJoin: ({ roomId, claims }) => !roomId.startsWith('workspace:') \|\| roomId === `workspace:${claims.activeOrganizationId}`` | [src/convex/integrations/presence.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/integrations/presence.ts) |
| <a id="limit"></a> `limit?` | `number` | **`Experimental`** How many people a room lists at most. Default 50. | [src/convex/integrations/presence.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/integrations/presence.ts) |

## Functions

### setupPresence()

```ts
function setupPresence(components, options?): PresenceSetup;
```

Defined in: [src/convex/integrations/presence.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/integrations/presence.ts)

**`Experimental`**

Who is here, for a page, a document or a workspace: Convex's presence
component (`@convex-dev/presence`, mounted as `presence` in
`convex.config.ts`) behind the backend's sign-in. Export what it returns
from `backend/presence.ts`, and `useRoomPresence(roomId)` keeps the
signed-in person in the room and lists who else is there.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type |
| ------ | ------ |
| `components` | [`PresenceComponents`](#presencecomponents) |
| `options?` | [`SetupPresenceOptions`](#setuppresenceoptions) |

#### Returns

[`PresenceSetup`](#presencesetup)

#### Example

```ts [backend/presence.ts]
import { setupPresence } from 'nuxt-backend/presence'
import { components } from './_generated/api'

export const { list, heartbeat, disconnect } = setupPresence(components)
```
